title: Triple Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass | Brushed Bronze | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Clear countertop and vanity clutter with three tiers of storage in one classic, wall-mounted glass shelf in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Pairs with matching Carolina accessories for a warm, cohesive aesthetic
- Choose from 56 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate the room: designed to match the Carolina collection for a unified set of classic bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Triple glass shelf (wall mount)
- Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
- Mounting: Wall-mounted with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Materials: Thick, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Approx. installed size/weight (16-inch model): 16 in L x 5.54 in D x 16 in H; 11.2 lbs
Multiple designer finish options available
